usage.summary:
Implemented native identities, captured execution authority, immutable sources/selectors, strict evidence checks, safe proposal/dashboard display, and documentation while preserving legacy Go compatibility.

Run 6/6 passed formatting, vet, package tests and all acceptance checks; two tests were skipped. Earlier runs had intermittent existing container-test failures.

No scope expansion. The merger must record the D-0107 extension; affected CI Python and TLAPS suites remain required.
